name: William "Bill" Johnson
bio:
Bill Johnson's journey into motorsport began in his teens, tinkering with engines in his father's garage in rural North Carolina. His passion led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, after which he quickly found his niche in racing. He honed his skills in various racing series before making his way to NASCAR, where he has established himself as a dependable and insightful race engineer. He is known for his methodical approach to problem-solving and his ability to extract maximum performance from the car through data analysis and precise adjustments.

At 23XI Racing, Bill is valued for his unflappable demeanor under pressure and his talent for translating driver feedback into actionable changes. He prioritizes clear communication and collaboration, believing that a cohesive team is the key to success on the track. While he isn't the most flashy or outspoken member of the team, his consistent performance and quiet dedication make him an invaluable asset. His knack for finding innovative solutions within the rulebook is a hallmark of his work.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Bill is a man of medium build, with a face that shows the wisdom and wear of years spent at the racetrack.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of coffee before every race.
